2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import json
6	from dataclasses import asdict
7	from pathlib import Path
8	
9	import numpy as np
10	
11	from .assembly import (
12	    assemble_kinetic_blocks_from_coefficients,
13	    assemble_potential_blocks_from_coefficients,
14	)
15	from .coefficients import map_fourin_grid_to_coefficients
16	from .energy import compute_energy_from_blocks
17	from .modes import TerpsichoreModeTable
18	from .options import TerpsichoreOptions
19	from .radial import TerpsichoreRadialGrid
20	from .representation import resolve_representation
21	from .trig import build_trig_table
22	
23	
24	POTENTIAL_NAMES = ("AI", "CC", "DI", "EI", "GI", "BL", "BU")
25	KINETIC_NAMES = ("BA", "BB", "BC", "BD", "BE", "BG", "BH")
26	COEFFICIENT_NAMES = ("c0", "c1", "c2", "c3", "c4", "c5", "c6", "c7", "c8", "c9", "c10", "c11")
27	
28	
29	def load_case(path: str | Path) -> dict:
30	    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
31	
32	
33	def build_case_inputs(case: dict):
34	    pairs = np.asarray(case["mode_pairs"], dtype=int)
35	    options = TerpsichoreOptions(
36	        surfs=int(case["radial_intervals"]) + 1,
37	        modelk=int(case["modelk"]),
38	        parity="sin",
39	    )
40	    representation = resolve_representation(0.0)
41	    mode_table = TerpsichoreModeTable(
42	        m=pairs[:, 0],
43	        n=pairs[:, 1],
44	        nfp=int(case["nfp"]),
45	        parity=representation.xi_basis,
46	    )
47	    radial_grid = TerpsichoreRadialGrid.uniform(surfs=options.surfs)
48	    trig_table = build_trig_table(
49	        mode_table,
50	        nj=int(case["nj"]),
51	        nk=int(case["nk"]),
52	        nper=int(case["nper"]),
53	    )
54	    points = trig_table.pol.size
55	    intervals = radial_grid.n_intervals
56	    theta = trig_table.pol[:, None]
57	    zeta = trig_table.tor[:, None]
58	    s = radial_grid.centers[None, :]
59	    scale = float(case.get("signal_scale", 1.0))
60	
61	    wave_a = np.sin(theta - 2.0 * zeta + 0.3 * s)
62	    wave_b = np.cos(2.0 * theta + zeta - 0.2 * s)
63	    wave_c = np.sin(3.0 * theta - zeta + 0.4 * s)
64	    bjac = 1.35 + 0.08 * scale * wave_a + 0.03 * wave_b
65	    sigmab = 1.65 + 0.07 * wave_b + 0.02 * s
66	    taub = 2.15 + 0.05 * wave_c + 0.03 * s
67	    grid_data = {
68	        "sigmab": sigmab,
69	        "sigbs": 0.22 + 0.04 * wave_a - 0.02 * wave_c,
70	        "gstl": 0.31 + 0.03 * wave_b + 0.01 * s,
71	        "gssl": 0.74 + 0.05 * wave_a + 0.03 * wave_b,
72	        "gssu": 0.86 + 0.06 * wave_c + 0.02 * s,
73	        "bjac": bjac,
74	        "bjacs": 0.18 + 0.03 * wave_b - 0.01 * wave_c,
75	        "parjp": 0.27 + 0.04 * wave_a + 0.02 * wave_b,
76	        "gspl": 0.29 + 0.03 * wave_c + 0.01 * wave_a,
77	        "taub": taub,
78	        "gparp": 0.12 + 0.02 * wave_a + 0.01 * s,
79	        "gperp": 0.09 + 0.02 * wave_b - 0.01 * s,
80	        "parkur": 0.21 + 0.03 * wave_c,
81	        "pphotj": 0.11 + 0.02 * wave_a - 0.01 * wave_b,
82	    }
83	    centers = radial_grid.centers
84	    profiles = {
85	        "ftp": 0.92 + 0.08 * centers,
86	        "fpp": 1.28 + 0.06 * centers,
87	        "ftpp": 0.10 + 0.02 * centers,
88	        "fppp": 0.07 + 0.015 * centers,
89	        "ci": 0.23 + 0.025 * centers,
90	        "cj": 1.09 + 0.035 * centers,
91	        "cip": np.full(intervals, 0.025),
92	        "cjp": np.full(intervals, 0.018),
93	        "pp": 0.36 * (1.0 - 0.35 * centers),
94	        "s_centers": centers,
95	    }
96	    assert all(value.shape == (points, intervals) for value in grid_data.values())
97	    return representation, mode_table, radial_grid, trig_table, grid_data, profiles
98	
99	
100	def _array_signature(arrays: list[np.ndarray]) -> dict[str, float]:
101	    flat = np.concatenate([np.asarray(value, dtype=float).ravel() for value in arrays])
102	    weights = 1.0 + (np.arange(flat.size, dtype=float) % 29.0) / 29.0
103	    return {
104	        "l1": float(np.sum(np.abs(flat))),
105	        "l2": float(np.linalg.norm(flat)),
106	        "signed_moment": float(np.dot(flat, weights)),
107	        "max_abs": float(np.max(np.abs(flat))),
108	    }
109	
110	
111	def run_native_case(case: dict) -> dict:
112	    representation, mode_table, radial_grid, trig_table, grid_data, profiles = build_case_inputs(case)
113	    coefficients = map_fourin_grid_to_coefficients(
114	        grid_data=grid_data,
115	        profiles=profiles,
116	        mode_table=mode_table,
117	        trig_table=trig_table,
118	        modelk=int(case["modelk"]),
119	        dtdp=float(case["dtdp"]),
120	        cospar=representation.cospar,
121	        cospr2=representation.cospr2,
122	        fixed_boundary=True,
123	    )
124	    potential = assemble_potential_blocks_from_coefficients(
125	        c0=coefficients.get("c0"), c1=coefficients.get("c1"), c2=coefficients.get("c2"),
126	        c4=coefficients.get("c4"), c5=coefficients.get("c5"), c6=coefficients.get("c6"),
127	        c9=coefficients.get("c9"), ftp=profiles["ftp"], fpp=profiles["fpp"],
128	        ftpp=profiles["ftpp"], fppp=profiles["fppp"], ci=profiles["ci"],
129	        cj=profiles["cj"], radial_grid=radial_grid, mode_table=mode_table,
130	    )
131	    kinetic = assemble_kinetic_blocks_from_coefficients(
132	        c8=coefficients.get("c8"), c10=coefficients.get("c10"), c11=coefficients.get("c11"),
133	        radial_grid=radial_grid, mode_table=mode_table,
134	    )
135	    lmns = mode_table.size
136	    node = np.arange(radial_grid.n_intervals + 1, dtype=float)[None, :]
137	    interval = np.arange(radial_grid.n_intervals, dtype=float)[None, :]
138	    mode = np.arange(lmns, dtype=float)[:, None]
139	    xi = np.sin(0.31 * (mode + 1.0) + 0.27 * node) + 0.1 * np.cos(0.17 * node)
140	    eta = np.cos(0.23 * (mode + 1.0) - 0.19 * interval) - 0.08 * np.sin(0.29 * interval)
141	    energy = compute_energy_from_blocks(
142	        xi, eta, potential, kinetic, radial_grid, mode_table,
143	        diagnostics={"parfac": representation.parfac},
144	    )
145	    return {
146	        "representation": asdict(representation),
147	        "mode_count": int(lmns),
148	        "lookup_count": int(trig_table.lss),
149	        "trig": _array_signature([trig_table.tss, trig_table.tsc]),
150	        "fourin": _array_signature([coefficients.get(name) for name in COEFFICIENT_NAMES]),
151	        "lhsmat": _array_signature([getattr(potential, name) for name in POTENTIAL_NAMES]),
152	        "rhsmat": _array_signature([getattr(kinetic, name) for name in KINETIC_NAMES]),
153	        "energy": {
154	            "wp": float(energy.wp), "wk": float(energy.wk),
155	            "omega2": float(energy.omega2), "growth_rate": float(energy.growth_rate),
156	        },
157	    }
158

160	def run_comparison(path: str | Path) -> dict:
161	    target_case = load_case(path)
162	    baseline_case = dict(target_case)
163	    baseline_case["parfac"] = 0.0
164	    return {
165	        "case": target_case["name"],
166	        "baseline": run_native_case(baseline_case),
167	        "target": run_native_case(target_case),
168	    }

29	def _fortran_divisible(value, nper):
30	    return value - int(value / nper) * nper == 0
31	
32	
33	def build_lsx_lookup(mode_table, nper):
34	    """Build TERPSICHORE ``lsx/msx/nsx`` lookup for difference and sum modes."""
35	
36	    if nper <= 0:
37	        raise ValueError("nper must be positive.")
38	    ms = np.asarray(mode_table.m, dtype=int)
39	    ns = np.asarray(mode_table.n, dtype=int)
40	    lsx = {}
41	    msx = []
42	    nsx = []
43	    seen = set()
44	    for sign in (-1, 1):
45	        for lc in range(mode_table.size):
46	            for lr in range(mode_table.size):
47	                mval = int(ms[lc] + sign * ms[lr])
48	                nval = int(ns[lc] + sign * ns[lr])
49	                if not _fortran_divisible(nval, nper):
50	                    continue
51	                n_reduced = int(nval / nper)
52	                key = (mval, n_reduced)
53	                if key in seen:
54	                    continue
55	                seen.add(key)
56	                msx.append(mval)
57	                nsx.append(nval)
58	                # Store Fortran-style packed indices. Index 0 is a zero-valued
59	                # sentinel in CNA/CNB/TSS/TSC, while physical modes start at 1.
60	                # Fortran only fills parity 0; parity 1 remains the zero
61	                # sentinel used when sums/differences are not divisible by nper.
62	                lsx[(mval, n_reduced, 0)] = len(msx)
63	                lsx.setdefault((mval, n_reduced, 1), 0)
64	    return lsx, np.asarray(msx, dtype=int), np.asarray(nsx, dtype=int)

68	    """Build TERPSICHORE ``POL`` and ``TOR`` arrays using cospol indexing."""
69	
70	    if nj <= 0 or nk <= 0 or nper <= 0:
71	        raise ValueError("nj, nk and nper must be positive.")
72	    njk = nj * nk
73	    dth = 1.0 / nj
74	    dph = 1.0 / nk
75	    pol = np.empty(njk)
76	    tor = np.empty(njk)
77	    for jk in range(njk):
78	        pol[jk] = tpi * dth * (jk % nj)
79	        tor[jk] = tpi * dph * (jk // nj) / nper
80	    return pol, tor
81	
82	
83	def build_trig_table(mode_table, *, nj, nk, nper, pol=None, tor=None):
84	    """Build ``TSS``/``TSC`` tables for FOURIN native coefficient generation."""
85	
86	    lsx, msx, nsx = build_lsx_lookup(mode_table, nper=nper)
87	    if pol is None or tor is None:

91	        tor = np.asarray(tor, dtype=float)

94	    lss = len(msx)

97	    for idx, (mval, nval) in enumerate(zip(msx, nsx), start=1):

206	    lmns = mode_table.size
207	    intervals = cna.shape[2]
208	    shape = (lmns, lmns, intervals)
209	    coeffs = {name: np.zeros(shape) for name in ALL_COEFFICIENTS}
210	    indices = compute_fourin_mapping_indices(mode_table, nper=nper, lsx=lsx)
211	    ld = indices["ld"]
212	    lp = indices["lp"]
213	    for interval in range(intervals):
214	        coeffs["c2"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
215	            cna[1, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[1, lp, interval]
216	        )
217	        coeffs["c6"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
218	            cna[2, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[2, lp, interval]
219	        )
220	        coeffs["c7"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
221	            cna[3, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[3, lp, interval]
222	        )
223	        coeffs["c5"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
224	            cna[4, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[4, lp, interval]
225	        )
226	        coeffs["c0"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
227	            cna[6, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[6, lp, interval]
228	        )
229	        coeffs["c1"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
230	            cnb[1, ld, interval] + cospar * cnb[1, lp, interval]
231	        )
232	        coeffs["c3"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
233	            cnb[2, ld, interval] + cospar * cnb[2, lp, interval]
234	        )
235	        coeffs["c4"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
236	            cnb[3, ld, interval] + cospar * cnb[3, lp, interval]
237	        )
238	        if modelk > 1:
239	            coeffs["c8"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
240	                cnb[5, ld, interval] - cospar * cnb[5, lp, interval]
241	            )
242	            coeffs["c10"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
243	                cnb[4, ld, interval] + cospar * cnb[4, lp, interval]
244	            )
245	            coeffs["c11"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
246	                cnb[6, ld, interval] + cospar * cnb[6, lp, interval]
247	            )
248	        else:
249	            coeffs["c8"][:, :, interval] = dtdp * (
250	                cna[5, ld, interval] - cospar * cna[5, lp, interval]
251	            )
252	            coeffs["c11"][:, :, interval] = 0.0
253	            ftp_i = np.asarray(ftp, dtype=float)[interval]
254	            coeffs["c10"][:, :, interval] = (
255	                coeffs["c8"][:, :, interval] + dtdp * cospr2 * cna[5, lp, interval]
256	            ) / (4.0 * ftp_i * ftp_i)
257	    ftp_arr = np.asarray(ftp, dtype=float)
258	    fpp_arr = np.asarray(fpp, dtype=float)
259	    ftpp_arr = np.asarray(ftpp, dtype=float)
260	    fppp_arr = np.asarray(fppp, dtype=float)
261	    ci_arr = np.asarray(ci, dtype=float)
262	    cj_arr = np.asarray(cj, dtype=float)
263	    ql = np.asarray(mode_table.ql, dtype=float)
264	    ms = np.asarray(mode_table.m, dtype=float)
265	    ns = np.asarray(mode_table.n, dtype=float)
266	    if s_centers is None:
267	        s_centers_arr = (np.arange(intervals, dtype=float) + 0.5) / intervals
268	    else:
269	        s_centers_arr = np.asarray(s_centers, dtype=float)
270	        if s_centers_arr.shape != (intervals,):
271	            raise ValueError(f"s_centers must have shape {(intervals,)}, got {s_centers_arr.shape}.")
272	    ql_lc = ql[:, None]
273	    ql_lr = ql[None, :]
274	    for interval in range(intervals):
275	        si = s_centers_arr[interval]
276	        t0 = fpp_arr[interval] * ftpp_arr[interval] - ftp_arr[interval] * fppp_arr[interval]
277	        sqgbsq = cj_arr[interval] * fpp_arr[interval] - ci_arr[interval] * ftp_arr[interval]
278	        if abs(sqgbsq) < 1e-14:
279	            raise ValueError("FOURIN mapping encountered near-zero SQGBSQ denominator.")
280	        t2 = t0 / sqgbsq
281	        t3 = t0 * t0 / sqgbsq
282	        t4 = (cj_arr[interval] * fppp_arr[interval] - ci_arr[interval] * ftpp_arr[interval]) / sqgbsq
283	        pmn = (ms * fpp_arr[interval] - ns * ftp_arr[interval])[:, None]
284	        rmn = (ms * fpp_arr[interval] - ns * ftp_arr[interval])[None, :]
285	        coeffs["c9"][:, :, interval] = (
286	            coeffs["c7"][:, :, interval]
287	            + t0 * coeffs["c5"][:, :, interval]
288	            + t3 * coeffs["c6"][:, :, interval]
289	            + (t4 - ql_lc / si)
290	            * (t4 - ql_lr / si)
291	            * sqgbsq
292	            * coeffs["c0"][:, :, interval]
293	            + (t4 - (ql_lc + ql_lr) / si) * coeffs["c2"][:, :, interval]
294	            + pmn * rmn * coeffs["c3"][:, :, interval]
295	            - rmn
296	            * (
297	                t2 * coeffs["c4"][:, :, interval]
298	                + (t4 - ql_lc / si) * coeffs["c1"][:, :, interval]
299	            )
300	            - pmn
301	            * (
302	                t2 * coeffs["c4"][:, :, interval].T
303	                + (t4 - ql_lr / si) * coeffs["c1"][:, :, interval].T
304	            )
305	        )
306	    profiles = {
307	        "ftp": ftp_arr,
308	        "fpp": fpp_arr,
309	        "ftpp": ftpp_arr,
310	        "fppp": fppp_arr,
311	        "ci": ci_arr,
312	        "cj": cj_arr,
313	    }
314	    coeff_data = TerpsichoreCoefficientData(
315	        coefficients=coeffs,
316	        profiles=profiles,
317	        fixed_boundary=fixed_boundary,
318	        igreen=igreen,
319	    )
320	    return coeff_data

329	def compute_fourin_grid_functions(*, grid_data, profiles, interval, modelk=0):
330	    """Compute FOURIN plasma grid functions ``A0..A11`` for one interval.
331	
332	    This ports the plasma branches of Fortran ``FOURIN`` for reduced and
333	    physical kinetic energy models: NI (``modelk`` 0/2) and KO (``modelk`` 1/3).
334	    """
335	
336	    if modelk not in {0, 1, 2, 3}:
337	        raise ValueError("modelk must be one of 0, 1, 2, 3.")
338	    sigmab = _grid_array(grid_data, "sigmab")[:, interval]
339	    sigbs = _grid_array(grid_data, "sigbs")[:, interval]
340	    gstl = _grid_array(grid_data, "gstl")[:, interval]
341	    gssl = _grid_array(grid_data, "gssl")[:, interval]
342	    gssu = _grid_array(grid_data, "gssu")[:, interval]
343	    bjac = _grid_array(grid_data, "bjac")[:, interval]
344	    bjacs = _grid_array(grid_data, "bjacs")[:, interval]
345	    parjp = _grid_array(grid_data, "parjp")[:, interval]
346	    gspl = _grid_array(grid_data, "gspl")[:, interval] if "gspl" in grid_data else None
347	    ftp = np.asarray(profiles["ftp"], dtype=float)[interval]
348	    fpp = np.asarray(profiles["fpp"], dtype=float)[interval]
349	    ftpp = np.asarray(profiles.get("ftpp", np.zeros_like(profiles["ftp"])), dtype=float)[interval]
350	    fppp = np.asarray(profiles.get("fppp", np.zeros_like(profiles["ftp"])), dtype=float)[interval]
351	    ci = np.asarray(profiles["ci"], dtype=float)[interval]
352	    cj = np.asarray(profiles["cj"], dtype=float)[interval]
353	    pp = np.asarray(profiles["pp"], dtype=float)[interval]
354	    sqgbsq = cj * fpp - ci * ftp
355	    if abs(ftp) < 1e-14:
356	        raise ValueError("FOURIN grid functions encountered near-zero ftp denominator.")
357	    if abs(sqgbsq) < 1e-14:
358	        raise ValueError("FOURIN grid functions encountered near-zero SQGBSQ denominator.")
359	    if np.any(np.abs(sigmab) < 1e-14):
360	        raise ValueError("FOURIN grid functions encountered near-zero sigmab denominator.")
361	    gsplm = (sigbs / sigmab - fpp * gstl) / ftp
362	    if modelk in {1, 3}:
363	        taub = _grid_array(grid_data, "taub")[:, interval]
364	        gparp = _grid_array(grid_data, "gparp")[:, interval]
365	        gperp = _grid_array(grid_data, "gperp")[:, interval]
366	        parkur = _grid_array(grid_data, "parkur")[:, interval]
367	        pphotj = _grid_array(grid_data, "pphotj")[:, interval]
368	        if np.any(np.abs(taub) < 1e-14):
369	            raise ValueError("KO FOURIN grid functions encountered near-zero taub denominator.")
370	        sigtau = sigmab / taub
371	        t8 = cj * fppp - ci * ftpp
372	        if "cjp" in profiles and "cip" in profiles:
373	            t8 = t8 + np.asarray(profiles["cjp"], dtype=float)[interval] * fpp - np.asarray(profiles["cip"], dtype=float)[interval] * ftp
374	        pgradt = bjac * pp * (1.0 + sigtau) + gparp + sigtau * gperp
375	        funcs = {
376	            "a0": 1.0 / sigtau,
377	            "a1": sigbs / sigtau,
378	            "a2": pp * bjac + gperp,
379	            "a3": sigmab * gssl - (1.0 - 1.0 / sigtau) * sigbs * sigbs / sqgbsq,
380	            "a4": sigmab * (ci * gstl + cj * gsplm),
381	            "a5": parkur,
382	            "a6": gssu,
383	            "a7": (pgradt * bjacs) / (1.0 + sigtau)
384	            - (((gparp - gperp) * (pgradt + t8)) / (1.0 + sigtau) + sigbs * pphotj)
385	            / sqgbsq,
386	        }
387	    else:
388	        funcs = {
389	            "a0": 1.0 / sigmab,
390	            "a1": sigbs / sigmab,
391	            "a2": pp * bjac,
392	            "a3": gssl,
393	            "a4": ci * gstl + cj * gsplm,
394	            "a5": parjp,
395	            "a6": gssu / sigmab,
396	            "a7": pp * bjac * bjacs,
397	        }
398	    if modelk in {2, 3}:
399	        if gspl is None:
400	            raise ValueError("physical kinetic energy models require grid_data['gspl'] for A11.")
401	        funcs["a8"] = bjac * bjac * gssl
402	        funcs["a10"] = bjac * bjac * funcs["a6"] / sqgbsq
403	        funcs["a11"] = -bjac * bjac * (ci * gstl + cj * gspl) / sqgbsq
404	    else:
405	        zeros = np.zeros_like(sigmab)
406	        funcs["a8"] = zeros
407	        funcs["a10"] = zeros
408	        funcs["a11"] = zeros
409	    return funcs
410

412	def accumulate_fourin_integrals_from_grid_functions(*, functions, tsc, tss, bjac):
413	    """Accumulate one-interval ``cna``/``cnb`` from FOURIN grid functions.
414	
415	    This ports the visible summation loops after ``A0..A11`` construction in
416	    Fortran ``FOURIN``.  The trigonometric tables are expected in TERPSICHORE's
417	    ``(lss, njk)`` layout.
418	    """
419	
420	    tsc = np.asarray(tsc, dtype=float)
421	    tss = np.asarray(tss, dtype=float)
422	    bjac = np.asarray(bjac, dtype=float)
423	    if tsc.shape != tss.shape:
424	        raise ValueError("tsc and tss must have the same shape.")
425	    if bjac.shape != (tsc.shape[1],):
426	        raise ValueError("bjac must have shape (njk,).")
427	    lss_with_sentinel = tsc.shape[0]
428	    cna = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel))
429	    cnb = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel))
430	    cna[1] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a2"], dtype=float)
431	    cna[2] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a6"], dtype=float)
432	    cna[3] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a7"], dtype=float)
433	    cna[4] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a5"], dtype=float)
434	    cna[5] = tsc @ bjac
435	    cna[6] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a0"], dtype=float)
436	    cnb[1] = tss @ np.asarray(functions["a1"], dtype=float)
437	    cnb[3] = tss @ np.asarray(functions["a4"], dtype=float)
438	    cnb[4] = tss @ np.asarray(functions["a10"], dtype=float)
439	    cnb[2] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a3"], dtype=float)
440	    cnb[5] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a8"], dtype=float)
441	    cnb[6] = tsc @ np.asarray(functions["a11"], dtype=float)
442	    return cna, cnb
443

446	def compute_fourin_integral_arrays_from_grid(
447	    *, grid_data, profiles, trig_table, modelk=0
448	):
449	    """Compute raw FOURIN ``cna``/``cnb`` integral arrays from grid data."""
450	
451	    intervals = np.asarray(profiles["ftp"]).size
452	    lss_with_sentinel = trig_table.lss + 1
453	    cna = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel, intervals))
454	    cnb = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel, intervals))
455	    bjac = np.asarray(grid_data["bjac"], dtype=float)
456	    for interval in range(intervals):
457	        functions = compute_fourin_grid_functions(
458	            grid_data=grid_data, profiles=profiles, interval=interval, modelk=modelk
459	        )
460	        cna_i, cnb_i = accumulate_fourin_integrals_from_grid_functions(
461	            functions=functions,
462	            tsc=trig_table.tsc,
463	            tss=trig_table.tss,
464	            bjac=bjac[:, interval],
465	        )
466	        cna[:, :, interval] = cna_i
467	        cnb[:, :, interval] = cnb_i
468	    return cna, cnb

471	def _compute_outer_shell_integral_arrays_from_metric_data(*, vacuum_grid_data, trig_table):
472	    """Compute reduced outer-shell raw ``cna``/``cnb`` arrays.
473	
474	    The Fortran vacuum branch requires ``gppl``, ``gtpl``, ``gttl``, ``gstl``,
475	    ``gssl`` and ``gssu`` on pseudo-vacuum intervals ``ni+1..nvi``.  The QAS3
476	    ``fort.23`` oracle stores only part of this set, so callers must provide the
477	    missing metric terms from strict vacuum geometry reconstruction.
478	    """
479	
480	    required = ("gppl", "gtpl", "gttl", "gstl", "gssl", "gssu")
481	    missing = [name for name in required if vacuum_grid_data.get(name) is None]
482	    if missing:
483	        raise ValueError(
484	            "outer-shell integral construction requires metric arrays "
485	            + ", ".join(required)
486	            + f"; missing {tuple(missing)}"
487	        )
488	    arrays = {name: np.asarray(vacuum_grid_data[name], dtype=float) for name in required}
489	    shapes = {name: value.shape for name, value in arrays.items()}
490	    if len(set(shapes.values())) != 1:
491	        raise ValueError(f"outer-shell metric arrays must have identical shapes, got {shapes}")
492	    points, intervals = next(iter(shapes.values()))
493	    if trig_table.tsc.shape[1] != points or trig_table.tss.shape[1] != points:
494	        raise ValueError("outer-shell metric point count must match trigonometric tables.")
495	    lss_with_sentinel = trig_table.lss + 1
496	    cna = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel, intervals))
497	    cnb = np.zeros((7, lss_with_sentinel, intervals))
498	    cna[1] = trig_table.tsc @ arrays["gppl"]
499	    cna[2] = trig_table.tsc @ arrays["gtpl"]
500	    cna[3] = trig_table.tsc @ arrays["gttl"]
501	    cnb[1] = trig_table.tss @ arrays["gstl"]
502	    cnb[2] = trig_table.tsc @ arrays["gssl"]
503	    cnb[3] = trig_table.tss @ arrays["gssu"]
504	    return cna, cnb

520	    indices = compute_fourin_mapping_indices(mode_table, nper=nper, lsx=lsx)
521	    del indices, dtdp, cospar
522	    return TerpsichoreCoefficientData(coefficients=coeffs, fixed_boundary=False)

397	def assemble_kinetic_blocks_from_coefficients(
398	    *,
399	    c8,
400	    c10,
401	    c11,
402	    radial_grid,
403	    mode_table,
404	    fixed_boundary=True,
405	    igreen=0,
406	    zero_outer_bb=True,
407	):
408	    """Assemble the visible plasma branch of Fortran ``RHSMAT`` from coefficients."""
409	
410	    c8 = np.asarray(c8, dtype=float)
411	    c10 = np.asarray(c10, dtype=float)
412	    c11 = np.asarray(c11, dtype=float)
413	    lmns = mode_table.size
414	    n_intervals = radial_grid.n_intervals
415	    expected = (lmns, lmns, n_intervals)
416	    for name, arr in {"c8": c8, "c10": c10, "c11": c11}.items():
417	        if arr.shape != expected:
418	            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have shape {expected}, got {arr.shape}.")
419	    shape = expected
420	    BA = np.zeros(shape)
421	    BB = np.zeros(shape)
422	    BC = np.zeros(shape)
423	    BD = np.zeros(shape)
424	    BE = np.zeros(shape)
425	    BF = np.zeros(shape)
426	    BG = np.zeros(shape)
427	    BH = np.zeros(shape)
428	    BBl = np.zeros(shape)
429	    BBu = np.zeros(shape)
430	    ql = np.asarray(mode_table.ql, dtype=float)
431	    ni = radial_grid.ni
432	    upper_rows, upper_cols = np.triu_indices(lmns)
433	    for interval in range(min(n_intervals, ni)):
434	        si = radial_grid.centers[interval]
435	        dsvar = -ni * radial_grid.ds[interval]
436	        sii = 0.5 / si**ql
437	        siis = np.outer(sii, sii)
438	        bc_upper = dsvar * siis * c8[:, :, interval]
439	        bbl_upper = bc_upper.copy()
440	        be_lc_lr = dsvar * sii[:, None] * c11[:, :, interval]
441	        be_lr_lc = dsvar * sii[None, :] * c11[:, :, interval].T
442	        if interval == 0:
443	            bc_upper = np.zeros_like(bc_upper)
444	            be_lc_lr = np.zeros_like(be_lc_lr)
445	            be_lr_lc = np.zeros_like(be_lr_lc)
446	        BBl[upper_rows, upper_cols, interval] = bbl_upper[upper_rows, upper_cols]
447	        BBu[upper_rows, upper_cols, interval] = bc_upper[upper_rows, upper_cols]
448	        BC[upper_rows, upper_cols, interval] = bc_upper[upper_rows, upper_cols]
449	        BC[upper_cols, upper_rows, interval] = bc_upper[upper_rows, upper_cols]
450	        BE[upper_rows, upper_cols, interval] = be_lc_lr[upper_rows, upper_cols]
451	        BE[upper_cols, upper_rows, interval] = be_lr_lc[upper_rows, upper_cols]
452	        BG[upper_rows, upper_cols, interval] = be_lr_lc[upper_rows, upper_cols]
453	        BG[upper_cols, upper_rows, interval] = be_lc_lr[upper_rows, upper_cols]
454	        bd_upper = dsvar * c10[:, :, interval]
455	        BD[upper_rows, upper_cols, interval] = bd_upper[upper_rows, upper_cols]
456	        BD[upper_cols, upper_rows, interval] = bd_upper[upper_rows, upper_cols]
457	        BF[:, :, interval] = BE[:, :, interval].T
458	        BA[:, :, interval] = BC[:, :, interval].T
459	        BH[:, :, interval] = BG[:, :, interval].T
460	        if fixed_boundary and interval == ni - 1 and igreen == 0:
461	            BBl[:, :, interval] = 0.0
462	            BC[:, :, interval] = 0.0
463	            BG[:, :, interval] = 0.0
464	            BA[:, :, interval] = 0.0
465	            BH[:, :, interval] = 0.0
466	            BB[:, :, interval] = 0.0
467	    if n_intervals:
468	        BB[:, :, :] = BBl
469	        if n_intervals > 1:

471	        if zero_outer_bb:
472	            BB[:, :, -1] = 0.0
473	    return TerpsichoreKineticBlocks(
474	        BA=BA, BB=BB, BC=BC, BD=BD, BE=BE, BF=BF, BG=BG, BH=BH, BBl=BBl, BBu=BBu
475	    )

495	def variable_slices(lmns, n_intervals):
496	    """Return global vector slices for TERPSICHORE ``XI`` and ``ETA`` variables."""
497	
498	    xi = [slice(i * lmns, (i + 1) * lmns) for i in range(n_intervals + 1)]
499	    eta_offset = (n_intervals + 1) * lmns
500	    eta = [slice(eta_offset + i * lmns, eta_offset + (i + 1) * lmns) for i in range(n_intervals)]

504	def assemble_potential_matrix(potential_blocks, radial_grid, mode_table):
505	    """Assemble the global potential matrix used by TERPSICHORE ``ENERGY``.
506	
507	    The matrix satisfies ``x.T @ K @ x == WP`` for a global vector ordered as
508	    ``[XI(0), ..., XI(N), ETA(1), ..., ETA(N)]``.  It follows the symmetrized
509	    quadratic form in Fortran ``ENERGY``.
510	    """
511	
512	    lmns = mode_table.size
513	    n_intervals = radial_grid.n_intervals
514	    dim = (2 * n_intervals + 1) * lmns
515	    K = np.zeros((dim, dim))
516	    xi, eta = variable_slices(lmns, n_intervals)
517	    for interval in range(n_intervals):
518	        i = interval
519	        x0 = np.arange(xi[i].start, xi[i].stop)
520	        x1 = np.arange(xi[i + 1].start, xi[i + 1].stop)
521	        e = np.arange(eta[i].start, eta[i].stop)
522	        _add_quadratic(K, x0, x0, _interval_block(potential_blocks.BU, i))
523	        _add_quadratic(K, x0, e, 0.5 * _interval_block(potential_blocks.EI, i))
524	        _add_quadratic(K, x0, x1, 0.5 * _interval_block(potential_blocks.CC, i))
525	        _add_quadratic(K, e, x0, 0.5 * _interval_block(potential_blocks.FI, i))
526	        _add_quadratic(K, e, e, _interval_block(potential_blocks.DI, i))
527	        _add_quadratic(K, e, x1, 0.5 * _interval_block(potential_blocks.GI, i))
528	        _add_quadratic(K, x1, x0, 0.5 * _interval_block(potential_blocks.AI, i))
529	        _add_quadratic(K, x1, e, 0.5 * _interval_block(potential_blocks.HI, i))
530	        _add_quadratic(K, x1, x1, _interval_block(potential_blocks.BL, i))
531	    return K

39	def split_global_vector(vector, radial_grid, mode_table):
40	    """Split a global vector into TERPSICHORE ``XI`` and ``ETA`` arrays."""
41	
42	    vector = np.asarray(vector, dtype=float)
43	    lmns = mode_table.size
44	    n_intervals = radial_grid.n_intervals
45	    xi_size = (n_intervals + 1) * lmns
46	    expected = (2 * n_intervals + 1) * lmns
47	    if vector.size != expected:
48	        raise ValueError(f"global vector has size {vector.size}, expected {expected}.")
49	    xi = vector[:xi_size].reshape((n_intervals + 1, lmns)).T
50	    eta = vector[xi_size:].reshape((n_intervals, lmns)).T

58	def compute_block_energy_contributions(xi, eta, potential_blocks, kinetic_blocks, radial_grid):
59	    """Return per-interval ``WP`` and ``WK`` contributions using Fortran semantics.
60	
61	    Fortran ``ENERGY`` only fills/uses the upper triangle for each interval and
62	    then doubles off-diagonal contributions. This implementation keeps that
63	    exact reduction but performs each interval as vectorized NumPy operations
64	    instead of Python ``lmns**2`` loops.
65	    """
66	
67	    xi = np.asarray(xi, dtype=float)
68	    eta = np.asarray(eta, dtype=float)
69	    n_intervals = radial_grid.n_intervals
70	    if xi.shape[1] != n_intervals + 1:
71	        raise ValueError("xi must have one more radial node than intervals.")
72	    if eta.shape[1] != n_intervals:
73	        raise ValueError("eta must have one radial value per interval.")
74	    lmns = xi.shape[0]
75	    wp_by_interval = np.zeros(n_intervals)
76	    wk_by_interval = np.zeros(n_intervals)
77	    upper_mask = np.triu(np.ones((lmns, lmns), dtype=bool), k=1)
78	    diag = np.diag_indices(lmns)
79	    for interval in range(n_intervals):
80	        x0 = xi[:, interval]
81	        x1 = xi[:, interval + 1]
82	        e = eta[:, interval]
83	        x0_x0 = np.outer(x0, x0)
84	        x0_e = np.outer(x0, e)
85	        x0_x1 = np.outer(x0, x1)
86	        e_x0 = np.outer(e, x0)
87	        e_e = np.outer(e, e)
88	        e_x1 = np.outer(e, x1)
89	        x1_x0 = np.outer(x1, x0)
90	        x1_e = np.outer(x1, e)
91	        x1_x1 = np.outer(x1, x1)
92	        potential_terms = (
93	            potential_blocks.BU[:, :, interval] * x0_x0
94	            + potential_blocks.EI[:, :, interval] * x0_e
95	            + potential_blocks.CC[:, :, interval] * x0_x1
96	            + potential_blocks.FI[:, :, interval] * e_x0
97	            + potential_blocks.DI[:, :, interval] * e_e
98	            + potential_blocks.GI[:, :, interval] * e_x1
99	            + potential_blocks.AI[:, :, interval] * x1_x0
100	            + potential_blocks.HI[:, :, interval] * x1_e
101	            + potential_blocks.BL[:, :, interval] * x1_x1
102	        )
103	        wp_by_interval[interval] = float(
104	            np.trace(potential_terms) + 2.0 * potential_terms[upper_mask].sum()
105	        )
106	        kinetic_terms = (
107	            kinetic_blocks.BE[:, :, interval] * x0_e
108	            + kinetic_blocks.BC[:, :, interval] * x0_x1
109	            + kinetic_blocks.BF[:, :, interval] * e_x0
110	            + kinetic_blocks.BD[:, :, interval] * e_e
111	            + kinetic_blocks.BG[:, :, interval] * e_x1
112	            + kinetic_blocks.BA[:, :, interval] * x1_x0
113	            + kinetic_blocks.BH[:, :, interval] * x1_e
114	            + kinetic_blocks.BB[:, :, interval] * x1_x1
115	        )
116	        wk_by_interval[interval] = float(
117	            kinetic_terms[diag].sum() + 2.0 * kinetic_terms[upper_mask].sum()
118	        )
119	    return wp_by_interval, wk_by_interval
120	
121	
122	def compute_block_quadratic_energy(xi, eta, potential_blocks, kinetic_blocks, radial_grid):
123	    """Compute ``WP`` and ``WK`` directly from TERPSICHORE blocks.
124	
125	    This is algebraically equivalent to assembling the dense global matrices but
126	    avoids materializing the very large QAS3 matrices during benchmark parity
127	    diagnostics.
128	    """
129	
130	    wp_by_interval, wk_by_interval = compute_block_energy_contributions(
131	        xi, eta, potential_blocks, kinetic_blocks, radial_grid
132	    )
133	    return float(wp_by_interval.sum()), float(wk_by_interval.sum())
134	
135	
136	def compute_fortran_energy_oracle_arrays(
137	    xi, eta, potential_blocks, kinetic_blocks, radial_grid
138	):
139	    """Return arrays in Fortran ``ENERGY`` dump convention.
140	
141	    ``compute_block_energy_contributions`` returns the integrated contribution
142	    to ``WP`` on each interval. Fortran dumps ``WPSI`` before multiplying by
143	    ``dsvar = ni * (s(i) - s(i-1))``, so ``WPSI`` is an interval density.
144	    ``WK_i`` is already an integrated per-interval increment and is returned
145	    unchanged.
146	    """
147	
148	    wp_by_interval, wk_by_interval = compute_block_energy_contributions(
149	        xi, eta, potential_blocks, kinetic_blocks, radial_grid
150	    )
151	    dsvar = radial_grid.ni * np.asarray(radial_grid.ds, dtype=float)
152	    if np.any(dsvar == 0):
153	        raise ValueError("radial grid contains a zero-width interval.")
154	    return {"WPSI": wp_by_interval / dsvar, "WK_i": wk_by_interval}
155	
156	
157	def compute_energy_from_blocks(
158	    xi,
159	    eta,
160	    potential_blocks,
161	    kinetic_blocks,
162	    radial_grid,
163	    mode_table,
164	    *,
165	    walf=1.0,
166	    diagnostics=None,
167	):
168	    """Compute a stability result from block arrays and split ``XI/ETA``."""
169	
170	    wp, wk = compute_block_quadratic_energy(
171	        xi, eta, potential_blocks, kinetic_blocks, radial_grid
172	    )
173	    return compute_energy(
174	        wp,
175	        wk,
176	        walf=walf,
177	        eigenvector_xi=np.asarray(xi, dtype=float),
178	        eigenvector_eta=np.asarray(eta, dtype=float),
179	        mode_table=mode_table,
180	        radial_grid=radial_grid,
181	        diagnostics={} if diagnostics is None else diagnostics,
182	    )

186	    vector,
187	    potential_blocks,
188	    kinetic_blocks,
189	    radial_grid,
190	    mode_table,
191	    *,
192	    walf=1.0,
193	    diagnostics=None,

204	    return compute_energy(

8	@dataclass(frozen=True)
9	class TerpsichoreRadialGrid:
10	    """TERPSICHORE-style radial grid in normalized toroidal flux ``s``."""
11	
12	    s_nodes: np.ndarray
13	    ni: int
14	    ivac: int = 0
15	
16	    def __post_init__(self):
17	        s_nodes = np.asarray(self.s_nodes, dtype=float)
18	        if s_nodes.ndim != 1:
19	            raise ValueError("s_nodes must be one-dimensional.")
20	        if s_nodes.size != self.ni + self.ivac + 1:
21	            raise ValueError("s_nodes length must equal ni + ivac + 1.")
22	        if self.ni < 1:
23	            raise ValueError("ni must be positive.")
24	        if self.ivac < 0:
25	            raise ValueError("ivac must be non-negative.")
26	        if np.any(np.diff(s_nodes) <= 0):
27	            raise ValueError("s_nodes must be strictly increasing.")
28	        if not np.isclose(s_nodes[0], 0.0):
29	            raise ValueError("s_nodes must start at 0.")
30	        if not np.isclose(s_nodes[self.ni], 1.0):
31	            raise ValueError("plasma boundary s_nodes[ni] must be 1.")
32	        object.__setattr__(self, "s_nodes", s_nodes)
33	
34	    @property
35	    def n_intervals(self):
36	        return self.ni + self.ivac
37	
38	    @property
39	    def centers(self):
40	        return 0.5 * (self.s_nodes[1:] + self.s_nodes[:-1])
41	
42	    @property
43	    def ds(self):
44	        return np.diff(self.s_nodes)
45	
46	    @property
47	    def plasma_slice(self):
48	        return slice(0, self.ni)
49	
50	    @property
51	    def vacuum_slice(self):
52	        return slice(self.ni, self.ni + self.ivac)
53	
54	    def plasma_view(self):
55	        """Return a grid view containing only plasma intervals."""
56	
57	        return type(self)(s_nodes=self.s_nodes[: self.ni + 1], ni=self.ni, ivac=0)
58	
59	    @classmethod
60	    def uniform(cls, surfs=101, ivac=0, dsvac=0.0):
61	        """Create a uniform plasma mesh plus optional uniform vacuum mesh."""
62	
63	        if surfs < 2:
64	            raise ValueError("surfs must be at least 2.")
65	        ni = surfs - 1
66	        plasma = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, surfs)
67	        if ivac:
68	            vacuum = np.linspace(1.0, 1.0 + dsvac, ivac + 1)[1:]
69	            s_nodes = np.concatenate((plasma, vacuum))
70	        else:
71	            s_nodes = plasma
72	        return cls(s_nodes=s_nodes, ni=ni, ivac=ivac)

129	        key: scaled_inputs[key]
130	        for key in (
131	            "rpvi",
132	            "vpvi",
133	            "zpvi",
134	            "rtpvi",
135	            "vtpvi",
136	            "ztpvi",
137	            "rppvi",
138	            "vppvi",
139	            "zppvi",
140	            "rspvi",
141	            "vspvi",
142	            "zspvi",
143	            "rstpvi",
144	            "vstpvi",
145	            "zstpvi",
146	            "rsppvi",
147	            "vsppvi",
148	            "zsppvi",
149	        )
150	    }
151	    points = boundary["rpvi"].shape[0]
152	    ramp = np.linspace(0.15, 0.55, points)
153	    wall_a = {
154	        "rwall": boundary["rpvi"] + 1.6 + ramp,
155	        "zwall": boundary["zpvi"] - 0.9 - 0.6 * ramp,
156	        "rtwall": boundary["rtpvi"] + 0.7,
157	        "ztwall": boundary["ztpvi"] - 0.5,
158	        "rpwall": boundary["rppvi"] + 0.45 + 0.4 * ramp,
159	        "zpwall": boundary["zppvi"] - 0.25 - 0.3 * ramp,
160	    }
161	    wall_b = {
162	        "rwall": wall_a["rwall"] + np.linspace(0.8, 1.4, points),
163	        "zwall": wall_a["zwall"] - np.linspace(0.5, 0.9, points),
164	        "rtwall": wall_a["rtwall"] + 0.55,

166	        "rpwall": wall_a["rpwall"] + np.linspace(0.3, 0.7, points),
167	        "zpwall": wall_a["zpwall"] - np.linspace(0.1, 0.4, points),
168	    }
169	    return wall_a, wall_b

66	    mode_table,

70	    wall=None,
71	    wall_scale: float = 1.0,
72	    nowall: int = 1,
73	):
74	    radial_grid = equilibrium_data.radial_grid
75	    plasma_grid = _plasma_grid(radial_grid)
76	    plasma_coefficients = _legacy_coefficients(
77	        equilibrium_data.data["terpsichore_coefficients"]
78	    )
79	    plasma_potential = assemble_potential_blocks_from_coefficients(
80	        c0=plasma_coefficients["c0"],
81	        c1=plasma_coefficients["c1"],
82	        c2=plasma_coefficients["c2"],
83	        c4=plasma_coefficients["c4"],

90	        fppp=plasma_coefficients["fppp"],
91	        ci=plasma_coefficients["ci"],
92	        cj=plasma_coefficients["cj"],
93	        radial_grid=plasma_grid,

1	"""Native pseudo-vacuum geometry helpers for the TERPSICHORE-native task."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	from dataclasses import dataclass
6	
7	import numpy as np
8	
9	
10	@dataclass(frozen=True)
11	class TerpsichoreVacmetData:
12	    bjac: np.ndarray
13	    gppl: np.ndarray
14	    gtpl: np.ndarray
15	    gttl: np.ndarray
16	    gssu: np.ndarray
17	    gstl: np.ndarray
18	    gssl: np.ndarray
19	    rvac: np.ndarray
20	    vp: np.ndarray
21	
22	    def as_vacuum_grid_data(self):
23	        return {
24	            "bjac": self.bjac,
25	            "gppl": self.gppl,
26	            "gtpl": self.gtpl,
27	            "gttl": self.gttl,
28	            "gssu": self.gssu,
29	            "gstl": self.gstl,
30	            "gssl": self.gssl,
31	        }
32	
33	
34	def _as_vector(values, name: str, size: int) -> np.ndarray:
35	    arr = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
36	    if arr.shape != (size,):
37	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must have shape ({size},), got {arr.shape}.")
38	    return arr
39	
40	
41	def _as_nodes(values, name: str, min_size: int) -> np.ndarray:
42	    arr = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
43	    if arr.ndim != 1 or arr.size < min_size:
44	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be one-dimensional with at least {min_size} values.")
45	    return arr
46	
47	
48	def compute_vacmet_metrics(
49	    *,
50	    s_nodes,
51	    ni,
52	    ivac,
53	    dsvac,
54	    pvac,
55	    qvac,
56	    nowall,
57	    rpvi,
58	    vpvi,
59	    zpvi,
60	    rtpvi,
61	    vtpvi,
62	    ztpvi,
63	    rppvi,
64	    vppvi,
65	    zppvi,
66	    rspvi,
67	    vspvi,
68	    zspvi,
69	    rstpvi,
70	    vstpvi,
71	    zstpvi,
72	    rsppvi,
73	    vsppvi,
74	    zsppvi,
75	    rwall,
76	    zwall,
77	    rtwall,
78	    ztwall,
79	    rpwall,
80	    zpwall,
81	    tor=None,
82	):
83	    if ivac < 0:
84	        raise ValueError("ivac must be non-negative.")
85	    s_nodes = _as_nodes(s_nodes, "s_nodes", ni + ivac + 1)
86	    if ivac == 0:
87	        empty = np.zeros((0, 0))
88	        return TerpsichoreVacmetData(
89	            bjac=empty,
90	            gppl=empty,
91	            gtpl=empty,
92	            gttl=empty,
93	            gssu=empty,
94	            gstl=empty,
95	            gssl=empty,
96	            rvac=empty,
97	            vp=np.zeros(0),
98	        )
99	    if dsvac == 0:
100	        raise ValueError("dsvac must be non-zero when ivac > 0.")
101	
102	    base = np.asarray(rpvi, dtype=float)
103	    if base.ndim != 1:
104	        raise ValueError("VACMET geometry arrays must be one-dimensional.")
105	    njk = base.size
106	    names = {
107	        "rpvi": rpvi,
108	        "vpvi": vpvi,
109	        "zpvi": zpvi,
110	        "rtpvi": rtpvi,
111	        "vtpvi": vtpvi,
112	        "ztpvi": ztpvi,
113	        "rppvi": rppvi,
114	        "vppvi": vppvi,
115	        "zppvi": zppvi,
116	        "rspvi": rspvi,
117	        "vspvi": vspvi,
118	        "zspvi": zspvi,
119	        "rstpvi": rstpvi,
120	        "vstpvi": vstpvi,
121	        "zstpvi": zstpvi,
122	        "rsppvi": rsppvi,
123	        "vsppvi": vsppvi,
124	        "zsppvi": zsppvi,
125	        "rwall": rwall,
126	        "zwall": zwall,
127	        "rtwall": rtwall,
128	        "ztwall": ztwall,
129	        "rpwall": rpwall,
130	        "zpwall": zpwall,
131	    }
132	    arrays = {name: _as_vector(value, name, njk) for name, value in names.items()}
133	    tor_arr = np.zeros(njk) if tor is None else _as_vector(tor, "tor", njk)
134	
135	    bjac = np.zeros((njk, ivac))
136	    gppl = np.zeros_like(bjac)
137	    gtpl = np.zeros_like(bjac)
138	    gttl = np.zeros_like(bjac)
139	    gssu = np.zeros_like(bjac)
140	    gstl = np.zeros_like(bjac)
141	    gssl = np.zeros_like(bjac)
142	    rvac = np.zeros_like(bjac)
143	    vp = np.zeros(ivac)
144	    nwalt = abs(nowall)
145	    wall_phase = tor_arr if nowall >= 0 else arrays["vpvi"]
146	    vpwall = np.ones(njk) if nowall >= 0 else arrays["vppvi"]
147	    vtwall = np.zeros(njk) if nowall >= 0 else arrays["vtpvi"]
148	
149	    for interval in range(ivac):
150	        svach = 0.5 * (s_nodes[ni + interval + 1] + s_nodes[ni + interval])
151	        svac0 = svach - 1.0
152	        ratio = svac0 / dsvac
153	        svac1 = 1.0 - nwalt * ratio**pvac
154	        svac2 = svac0 * (1.0 - nwalt * ratio ** (pvac - 1.0))
155	        svac3 = nwalt * ratio**qvac
156	        svac4 = -nwalt * pvac / dsvac * ratio ** (pvac - 1.0)
157	        svac5 = 1.0 - nwalt * pvac * ratio ** (pvac - 1.0)
158	        svac6 = nwalt * qvac / dsvac * ratio ** (qvac - 1.0)
159	
160	        rvac_i = svac1 * arrays["rpvi"] + svac3 * arrays["rwall"] + svac2 * arrays["rspvi"]
161	        rsvac = svac4 * arrays["rpvi"] + svac6 * arrays["rwall"] + svac5 * arrays["rspvi"]
162	        vsvac = svac4 * arrays["vpvi"] + svac6 * wall_phase + svac5 * arrays["vspvi"]
163	        zsvac = svac4 * arrays["zpvi"] + svac6 * arrays["zwall"] + svac5 * arrays["zspvi"]
